column1: # Merged 2026-08-07 from backfill_report.csv (1-96) + amendments_new.csv (97-106). 105th assent reconciled to 2021-08-19 (Gazette date; amendments_new.csv said 2021-08-18).

column4: Added the words "or co-operative societies" after "or unions" in Art 19(1)(c); inserted Art 43B (DPSP on promotion of co-operative societies) and Part IXB 'The Co-operative Societies' (Arts 243ZH-243ZT).
Inserted Art 371J - special provisions for the Hyderabad-Karnataka region: separate development board, equitable allocation of funds, reservation in education and employment for local residents.

Inserted Arts 124A, 124B, 124C - National Judicial Appointments Commission (NJAC); amended Arts 127, 128, 217, 222, 224A, 231. Notified 13 Apr 2015; struck down by Supreme Court 16 Oct 2015 (collegium system restored).
Gave effect to the India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement: amended First Schedule for exchange of enclave territories and conferred citizenship rights on enclave residents.

column2: The Constitution (One Hundred and First Amendment) Act, 2016
column4: Introduced Goods and Services Tax (GST): inserted Arts 246A, 269A, 279A (GST Council); deleted Art 268A; amended Arts 248, 249, 250, 268, 269, 270, 271, 286, 366, 368 and Sixth and Seventh Schedules. GST regime effective 1 July 2017.

column2: The Constitution (One Hundred and Second Amendment) Act, 2018
column4: Constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes: inserted Art 338B (NCBC) and Art 342A (President to specify SEBCs); amended Art 338; inserted Art 366(26C).

column2: The Constitution (One Hundred and Third Amendment) Act, 2019
column4: Inserted clause (6) in Arts 15 and 16 - up to 10% reservation for Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) in admission to educational institutions and public employment, in addition to existing reservations.

column2: The Constitution (One Hundred and Fourth Amendment) Act, 2019
column4: Amended Art 334: extended SC/ST reservation of seats in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 10 years (to 25 Jan 2030); Anglo-Indian nominated seats in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies (Arts 331, 333) ceased. In force 25 Jan 2020.

column2: The Constitution (One Hundred and Fifth Amendment) Act, 2021
column4: Restored States' power to identify OBCs/SEBCs: substituted Art 342A (Explanation and clause (3) - States/UTs may by law prepare and maintain their own SEBC lists, which may differ from the Central List); inserted proviso to Art 338B(9); substituted Art 366(26C).

column2: The Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023
column4: Women's reservation (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam): inserted Arts 330A (Lok Sabha), 332A (State Assemblies) and 334A (15-year reservation from commencement of delimitation, with rotation); amended Art 239AA (Delhi Assembly). Substantive provisions commence on a date to be notified after delimitation.
